guideline.text: All children with fever should have a malaria test (RDT or blood slide). Uncomplicated malaria: artemether-lumefantrine by weight twice daily for 3 days with food: 5-14 kg 1 tablet per dose, 15-24 kg 2 tablets, 25-34 kg 3 tablets. Severe malaria (unable to drink, convulsions, lethargy, severe anaemia, jaundice): give artesunate IM or rectal and refer urgently. If no test is available and fever has no other cause, treat as malaria and refer for testing.
